1320.a: Lake Aoki, Taira, Omachi, Nagano 398-0001, Japan
1320.aj: 〒398-0001 長野県大町市平 青木湖
1320.ed: Known for its fall colors & spring blossoms, this lake is popular for camping, kayaking & birding.
1320.edj: 秋の紅葉と春の桜で有名。キャンプ、カヤック、バードウォッチングで人気の湖。

rv.t: lovely lake. not a big lake but simply beautiful because of the size, the Alps and the greenery. the cafe is a good place to have a cup of coffee to enjoy the view

Very beautiful water. Be respectful and take your rubbish. The locals don't like that it's becoming more well known. This was maybe my favourite day in Japan. Respect this place and the locals will respect you.
Stopped by in the winter and it was STUNNING very peaceful, calm, and relax. If you are on the way back from Hakuba to Tokyo, i would recommend to stop by and relax here!

1321.a: Japan, 〒305-0031 Ibaraki, Tsukuba, Azuma, 1 Chome−６−1 トナリエつくばスクエア Toraji, キュート3F

rv.t: I ate here while in town for a business conference. It was very tasty. I love a some good grilled food and here you have a grill right at your table. We ate here for lunch and had a little bit of a wait. I could see why when we started eating, the food was so delicious! I would definitely eat here again if I am back in town.

The quality of the meat here is pretty good, but the service is AWFUL. The majority of the wait staff are students who all seem to be completely new at their job -- it takes upwards of 10 minutes for them to fetch a new set of plates, and asking for a drink any time after placing the initial order is guaranteed to either go unfulfilled or take over 15 minutes until you remind them (at least twice). And there seem to…
A very quiet and cozy cafe great for meet ups with friend.

1322.a: Japan, 〒305-0031 Ibaraki, Tsukuba, Azuma, 3 Chome−7−15 パレス柴原-I 1 103 BURGER BOY
1322.aj: 〒305-0031 茨城県つくば市吾妻３丁目7−１５ パレス柴原-I 1 103 BURGER BOY
1322.ed: Diners like this burger joint's juicy, flavorful patties and fragrant, crispy buns, with many highlighting the generous portions. They also mention the reasonable prices for the quality and the friendly, attentive staff. Guests appreciate the clean, stylish atmosphere and convenient parking options nearby.
1322.edj: クチコミによると、このハンバーガー店は、ジューシーで風味豊かなパティと、香ばしくカリッとしたバンズが高く評価されています。多くの人がボリュームの多さを挙げています。また、品質に対して価格が手頃であることや、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフについても言及されています。清潔でおしゃれな雰囲気や、近くに便利な駐車場があることも、利用した人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Absolutely delicious! The burger was huge, it was a challenge. Just trying to eat it. Love the environment, very cosy and warm. The workers were very friendly and try to help me with directions. Would definitely recommend! 😄

This is the best burger I've had in Japan! It was so juicy and tender. The lettuce was super fresh and crisp. The Avocado was the perfect ripeness. The sauce on it was delicious. The fries were crispy and curly (and there was ketchup)! It was so good! Oh, and I got the tiny pickle too! It was great!

I came here the other day because I wanted to try their hamburgers. Because it was close to closing time I was the only person in the restaurant. The woman and the male chef who did all the cooking were extremely nice and made me feel at home. I ordered the double cheeseburger, which came with fries and a tiny pickle. Overall the meal was really good, a bit too much pepper I think but the burger was grilled very…

1323.nb: Khu đô thị Phú Mỹ Hưng, Tan Hung

rv.t: I’ve eaten at many Bánh Mì 362 branches before, and honestly I’ve always really liked the brand, which is why this review comes from someone who has been a loyal customer for a long time 😌 This branch is located in District 7, and one thing I do like is that parking is convenient right in front of the shop. There’s also a small seating area available if customers want to eat there directly. However, because the…

Some of the best bánh mì we had while in Vietnam. The beef one was especially amazing, juicy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The service was great, and it’s a nice spot to sit outside and enjoy your meal.

I’m a local & this defo NOT deserve a try! First I had to wait around 15-20 mins from order to pick up. So sooo hungryyy Second its a bit overpriced (54k VND for a signature one) so I expected something good like amazing tastes or special topping. But it turned out to be so average, nothing different tbh Totally not recommend

1324.a: Ōshimizu Park, 1 Chome-５-2 Takezono, Tsukuba, Ibaraki 305-0032, Japan
1324.aj: 〒305-0032 茨城県つくば市竹園１丁目５−２ 大清水公園

rv.t: Child zone, greenery etc...
芝生が広く、ベンチもあり過ごしやすい。広場の方ではキッチンカーなどが来るイベントがある。駐車場は、近隣の有料駐車場を使うことになるが、たくさんあるため困らない。
2025年1月9日㈭ トイレあり自販機ありベンチあり、雨が降ったら隣の施設の大きな屋根の下に避難可能。 駅前のデッキからそのまま行けるし便利だね。

1325.a: Japan, 〒141-0031 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Nishigotanda, 4 Chome−9−16 Hotel Vintage 目黒不動 前1F THE ORDY BAKERY
1325.aj: 〒141-0031 東京都品川区西五反田４丁目９−１６ Hotel Vintage 目黒不動 前1F THE ORDY BAKERY

rv.t: A cosy little coffee shop with delicious coffee and pastries, and the friendliest staffs. It’s also a lovely spot for brunch. I enjoyed my coffee here every day while staying at Hotel Vintage Meguro Fudomae, and it’s the place I’ll miss most when I leave Japan.
A pleasant café in Tokyo. I was quite satisfied with my visit — there was a nice selection to choose from, the coffee was good, and the atmosphere was enjoyable.

Well, the drinks are mediocre and overpriced and the loud, International-Ginza Spotify music soundtrack makes you cringe but honestly, it’s a hotel Café and there’s nothing like this in this neighborhood so we shouldn’t get too critical. It’s nice to sit outside on a sunny day on the tree line street and dogs are welcome, which is nice. Now, if they would just hire a bartender and do a proper cocktail lounge in the…

1326.a: dough-ist, ホワイトハウス 3 Chome-12-5 Sasazuka, Shibuya, Tokyo 151-0073, Japan
1326.aj: 〒151-0073 東京都渋谷区笹塚３丁目１２−５ ホワイトハウス dough-ist（ドウイスト）
1326.ed: People say this bakery offers a wide variety of unique, high-hydration breads and pastries, with many highlighting the distinctively fluffy and chewy texture of their signature "dough-ist" bread, donuts, and scones. Visitors also appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, who provide excellent service. They also mention the convenient cashless payment options and the option to purchase items…
1326.edj: クチコミによると、このパン屋は、珍しい高加水パンや焼き菓子を幅広く提供しており、特に「ドゥイスト」という名前のパンやドーナツ、スコーンは、独特のふわふわもちもちとした食感が特徴のようです。利用した人は、親しみやすく丁寧なスタッフの素晴らしいサービスも高く評価しています。また、便利なキャッシュレス決済やテイクアウトができる点も良いという声があります。

rv.t: Personally, I think this is the best serious bakery in Sasazuka area. Very creative and high quality product. I tried a cinnamon donut and a plain scone. Both were so delicious and different from what I’d had before. The donut was so soft and fluffy, with big air bubbles. They must have used a high-hydration dough for it. I really loved it. The scone has an interesting shape, simple but authentic taste. Highly…

Cute little shop with lots of baked items. We picked up a couple of donuts, almond croissant, and small bread like item. They were all super delicious but my personal favorite was the almond croissant. Wow!! I would go back in a heartbeat to try other items and get another almond croissant!! Note: no area to sit inside, but there are a few chairs outside (still, a must try place)
There are lots of the smell of freshly baked bread :) If you found donuts, you should eat them. It is so delicious that it melts in your mouth!

1326.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00（土）

1327.a: Lake Sammamish State Park, 2010 NW Sammamish Rd, Issaquah, WA 98027
1327.aj: レイク・サマミッシュ州立公園 2010 NW Sammamish Rd, Issaquah, WA 98027 アメリカ合衆国
1327.ed: 512-acre park with ample waterfront access & boat launch, plus seasonal kayak rentals & picnicking.

rv.t: This is a fantastic spot for a picnic or a get-together with friends and family. The park is very well-maintained, and it’s a great place to bring your own paddle board or kayak to enjoy some time out on the lake. If you don't have your own, they have a convenient rental location, and you can even book online ahead of time. Just a heads-up: remember to bring your Discovery Pass if you have one, or you’ll need to…

Lake Sammamish State Park is one of the most beautiful state parks in Washington. The scenery is absolutely stunning, with peaceful lake views and incredible horizons where the clouds roll over the tops of the mountains. It’s a perfect place to relax, meditate, go for a walk or jog, or bring your dog for some fresh air. It’s also a fantastic spot for families. There are plenty of activities to enjoy together, and…
Beautiful lake with big playground for grandkids. Latte, ice cream and fresh fried donuts at snack stand. Bald eagles. Short hike with birds and a beaver.

1328.aj: アメリカ合衆国 〒90704 カリフォルニア州 サンタ・カタリナ島
1328.ed: Scenic island 22 miles off the Southern California coast with hotels, beaches & seafood restaurants.
1328.edj: 南カリフォルニアの海岸から 22 マイル沖合にある風光明媚な島。ホテル、ビーチ、シーフード レストランがある。

rv.t: Santa Catalina Island is absolutely beautiful! The stunning views of the ocean and the rugged coastline are breathtaking. It feels like a slice of paradise just a short trip away. There’s a wealth of activities to enjoy, from hiking scenic trails to snorkeling in crystal-clear waters. I loved exploring the charming town of Avalon, with its shops and eateries, and the opportunities for kayaking and paddleboarding…

An hour ferry ride from Long Beach will take you to this beautiful island. It has a colorful ambience across island . One can go for a day trip or overnight stay . They have some good hotel to stay , nice restaurant and cafe. We took a golf cart to roam around the island .. it take not more then 2 hours to explore. Had some good coffee and handmade magnet.. overall a good day spent .

It was a very nice little short weekend getaway for those who lives in California or visiting California and want to do something away from the mainland. There’s a lot to do for one day, so better to stay overnight and just enjoy the restaurant, scenic views and hikes. Best to rent a golf cart to transport around.

It’s nice. grilled fishes are crispy & fresh. The price is still reasonable. The fish soup is also good. It’s not thick and strong compared to ordinary fish soup but I enjoyed it.

We can't speak Korean. Luckily, we dont need to order here because there is only fried fish here. Payment via number people. When we go inside. The staff arrange table for us very quickly. So satisfied

1331.ed: Diners like this cafe's hearty and satisfying onigiri sets, which include two large onigiri with various fillings, a flavorful dashi-infused omelet, and a rich pork soup. They also highlight the warm and welcoming atmosphere, as well as the friendly and attentive staff.
1331.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ボリューム満点で満足感のあるおにぎり定食が高く評価されています。おにぎり定食には、さまざまな具材を選べる大きめのおにぎり2個、だしの効いた卵焼き、具だくさんの豚汁が含まれています。温かく居心地の良い雰囲気や、親しみやすく丁寧なスタッフの対応も好評のようです。

rv.t: Stumbled upon this amazing restaurant in Kyoto and it instantly became one of my favorite food spots in the city. It’s a small, cozy onigiri-focused restaurant, but the flavors are on another level. I loved it so much that I went yesterday, then again this morning for breakfast, and came back for lunch — that’s how good it is 😋🤤 The food is hearty, homey, and incredibly satisfying without being heavy. Everything…

I was really looking forward to this place as it had great reviews and was an authentic Japanese meal. Pros: food was made fresh and it was a good price. Cons: incredibly slow service, very challenging to get anyone’s attention, and not vegetarian friendly, and it was not disclosed what foods had pork in them. Wouldn’t go back.

A cozy onigiri restaurant run by uni students!! The staff were super friendly and the food was amazing. I got the lunch set (two onigiris with miso soup and egg omelet) which was delicious and filling. The egg omelette “tamagoyaki” was super fluffy and had a very deep umami flavor from dashi!!! You could choose the filling of the onigiri and I chose salmon and egg yolk and minced meat, which I both LOVED!! Miso soup…

1332.a: National Maritime Museum of Korea, 45 Haeyang-ro 301beon-gil, Yeongdo-gu, Busan, South Korea
1332.aj: 国立海洋博物館 ４５ Haeyang-ro 301beon-gil, Yeongdo-gu, Busan, 韓国
1332.ed: Modern maritime museum with many relics & models, plus an aquarium tunnel & kids’ activities.
1332.edj: さまざまな遺物と模型を展示しているモダンな海洋博物館。水中トンネルがある。子供向けのアクティビティも用意されている。

rv.t: Worth the trip! - Beautiful building with no entrance fee - Nice exhibits featuring hand-picked periods - Things for children too One shame I thought, was that the big replica of an actual Joseon boat was sort of pushed to the side, instead of being featured with more facts in a “stand-out way”.
What a great museum for free of charge. Informative and educarional. Great view of the ocean from the top floor and nice place outside to stroll and enjoy when the weather is nice.
Nice place to visit with kids. Cannot believe this is free! Well maintained museum in Busan!

1333.a: 딤타오, 25 Udong 1-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, South Korea
1333.aj: 딤타오, ２５ Udong 1-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: A nice, calm spot with a pleasant atmosphere — especially since there was no crowd when I visited. I arrived about 10 minutes before the kitchen was closing and ordered wonton soup and beef ribs. Portion sizes turned out to be quite small, even considering it’s dim sum style. The wonton soup was good, though I wish it had been a bit hotter when served. The ribs had a nice flavor overall — there was one soft…
If you’re looking for a great dim sum spot in Busan, Dim Tao definitely hits the mark. I highly recommend the eggplant with shrimp. Honestly, you can’t go wrong just order the whole menu.

Nice clean and roomy place. Long line at lunch so arrive early or go later in the lunch hour. Shrimp dimsum, fried eggplant and wonton soup. Plenty enough for two people. The shrimp-stuffed fried eggplant is a very nice change of pace. Highly recommend it.

1334.a: Haeundae Amsogalbi-jip, 333 Haeundaehaebyeon-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, South Korea
1334.aj: Haeundae Amsogalbi-jip, ３３３ Haeundaehaebyeon-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: Haeundaegalbi (as it appears in Navers) was the best Korean bbq meal we had in our 5 day trip in Haeundae beach area. The interior decor is modern clean and spacious. Staff is friendly and efficient. Higher in price but reflects in the quality of the meat served. The marinated sirloin bulgogi was great but the clear winner was the marinated short rib - perfectly seasoned and cooked by service staff. Would come back…

This Michelin Restaurant is the best when it comes to Hanwoo Beef. The meat is tender, juicy, and has a nice chewiness. That nice “melt in your mouth” meat experience is one that Haeundae Amsogalbi-jip does extremely well. I loved the experience from start to finish. Staff are friendly, service was outstanding, and the side dishes that come with the meal were a great added touch. I have tried many great Korean BBQ…

Very popular beef BBQ restaurant in korea and is one of the Michelin star restaurants waiting almost more than 1 hour. My daughter are very happy, really like this KBBQ. According to my daughter, this is the second best beef compared to what they eat in Yoroniku Japan. The taste of the beef is very soft and it melts in your mount

1335.a: Casa Busano, 112 대청로 Jung-gu, Busan, South Korea
1335.aj: Casa Busano, １１２ 대청로 Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: The name Casa Busano is pretty hilarious and cute to me. Note: I love cappuccino especially one with the orange bite, o-busano-chino. One of my favorite hidden spots in Busan. Part of me wants to keep it a secret, but I’m also proud to share it. The café is located inside a former bank building (think of it as Korea’s version of a mint), so while you relax, you can still see the original vault doors and explore the…

This café is quite unique. I heard it was converted from an old bank, giving it a distinctive atmosphere. The space is large and relaxing, we ordered UBE drinks was so good and it also provides wide selection of breads and pastries. There’s also a museum connected to the café, so you can enjoy a visit there as well.
On the first floor of the Busan Modern and Contemporary Museum where a bank used to be in the past. Spacious open design and decent coffee and patries.

1336.a: Tateishi Park, 立石町-10399 Kamisuwa, Suwa, Nagano 392-0003, Japan
1336.aj: 〒392-0003 長野県諏訪市上諏訪立石町１０３９９ 立石公園
1336.ed: Hilltop park featured in a hit anime movie, with views over Lake Suwa, play areas & walking paths.
1336.edj: 有名なアニメ映画の風景を楽しめる、丘の上にある公園。諏訪湖を見渡せる。遊具のあるエリアと遊歩道もある。

rv.t: Absolutely beautiful! I ended up sitting here for 2.5 hours and it was one of my highlights from Japan. Definitely check Sunset time beforehand and get there early because it does get a little packed around then. I took a taxi up because it’s a steep hike up and I walked down, hike down is also steep and dark if you leave after the sun sets, because it’s the countryside there aren’t street lights everywhere so have…

Need a lot of effort to go here. Better if you take a car. If not, the hike up to the park is quite long and steep. I prefer took a cab up and walking down. I walk down right after sunset so it’s not too dark on the street. It’s a good decision because I could catch the blue hour on the way down and it was so pretty. This is the location of Itomori from anime Kimi no Nawa. Very beautiful during sunset.

📍 Tateishi Park 立石公園 @ Suwa, Nagano, Japan 🇯🇵 We visited Tateishi Park on 13 November 2025 at 10:40 AM, and although the weather was cloudy, the view over Lake Suwa from the park was still beautiful and peaceful. The area is serene, with a wide panoramic view of the lake, mountains, and Suwa city. Tateishi Park is also famous among fans of the movie “Your Name (君の名は)”, as its scenery closely resembles the iconic…

1337.a: Japan, 〒101-0044 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kajicho, 1 Chome−3−10 神田 鮨ひで
1337.aj: 〒101-0044 東京都千代田区鍛冶町１丁目３−１０ 神田 鮨ひで

rv.t: 神田 鮨ひで ・スペシャルランチ 12:00ぐらいにお伺いしました。 神田駅から1分。 駅近周辺でググって一目散にダッシュ💨 店舗ファサードはシンプルなベージュの外壁に店名サイン。 店内、檜カウンター10席、4人テーブル席×3。 和モダンなデザイン、綺麗で清潔感があります。 お客さんお一人様4名、女性2組。 店員の方々、対応良い感じです😊 ▪️寿司🍣 マグロ中トロ マグロ赤身 かんぱち 穴子 ぼたん海老 イカ サーモン 玉子 イクラ軍艦巻き 雲丹軍艦巻き ネギトロ軍艦巻き ネタは新鮮 マグロ中トロは脂ののりが良い、酢飯の酸味が合い美味しい。 赤身は熟成されて柔らかく旨みが強い。 かんぱちあっさりとした上品な味わいぷりぷり。 サーモンは特有の臭みなく意外とあっさり。 イカは柔らかく、程良い甘みがある 穴子は甘めのタレとのバランスが良い。 イクラ軍艦巻きはイクラのプチプチ感が良く、味も良い。 雲丹軍艦巻きは濃厚でまろやか。…

平日夜にふたりで訪問。清潔感のあるカウンターで、ケースに並ぶネタの美しさにまず惹かれました。 特筆すべきは自家製の燻製鯖。香りとうまみが絶妙で、お寿司屋さんで燻製という意外性もありながら、とても美味しかったです。ウイスキーにもよく合います。 旬のネタのお作りや握りもどれも絶品。赤酢のしゃりは小ぶりで食べやすく、ネタとのバランスも絶妙です。 大将の職人技とセンスが光る上質なお寿司でありながら、気取らず居心地のよいお店。またぜひ伺いたい良店です。

赤酢シャリに惹かれて初訪です。平日11時半過ぎ、年配客3組。ゆったりした店内に立派なカウンター、高級感ある。でもランチはリーズナブル。自分は海鮮丼、同僚は大江戸ランチを注文（各千円）。海鮮丼のネタ小ぶりながら種類多く、赤シャリは酢強めであっさり。美味しい！まさに江戸前。量十分だしアオサ味噌汁もいい。大江戸ランチは９貫握り、これまた良さげ。大将寡黙で仕事丁寧、夜の品書きも手頃（一人5-6千円位）。良質店ですｗ

1338.a: Coffee Bigaku Abe, NOVAビル 1 Chome-2-8 Fukashi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-0815, Japan
1338.aj: 〒390-0815 長野県松本市深志１丁目２−８ NOVAビル 珈琲美学 アベ
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1338.ed: Specialty coffees, desserts & light bites offered in a cozy, old-world atmosphere.
1338.edj: レトロな雰囲気漂う居心地の良い喫茶店。スペシャルティ コーヒーのほか、スイーツや軽食を楽しめる。

rv.t: The vibe and waiters are excellent. Coffee and toast are above- average. Worthy to pay a visit in the morning to avoid the long queue. Thanks for letting me have a good start in the morning!
A small beautiful French inspired cafe In Matsumoto. Excellent cafe au lait & focaccia bread . The chocolate & cheesecake are superb. Highly recommend but long queue

They serve a very good range of single origin coffee, prepared in their own methods, which is very well prepared. The different type of beans is on their menu and you can also bring back some beans. The toast was very nice as well - toasted to perfection. I also loved their kitchenware! Highly recommend this place to visitors of Matsumoto for breakfast/brunch! There might be a wait for seats though but it’s not…

1339.a: 송일정, 288-63 Songjeong-dong, Haeundae-gu, Busan, South Korea
1339.aj: 송일정, ２８８−６３ Songjeong-dong, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: It is small but really very place! It is in Jukdo mountain, more like a hill! Very nice park and view. Old people do sport in small sport area, kids are having Picnic with their teachers, youngs enjoy the break under trees! Surely a lovely place to take a break after walking through the Songjeong Beach! Sit on the top area or in the Pavillon, both very very nice!
Nice pavilion looking out to the ocean.
Nice Pavilion that is less than 5 mins walk from the main entrance. It have great view. It had a strong breeze when I visited.

1340.aj: Palawan Beach, シンガポール
1340.ed: Scenic strip of sand with calm waters & fine sand, plus a suspension bridge link to a small island.
1340.edj: 穏やかな海、きめの細かい砂、小さな島へ続く吊り橋がある、景色の良い細長いビーチ。

rv.t: Compared to pristine beaches with crystal clear waters, the does not charm you at all but the beach and surrounding facilities makes the location a good place to spend with friends and family.
Often visit the beach while having lunch at FOC. Seems to always be free from trash which is great to see. Enjoyed the MetaSprint Aquathlon event there recently where Truly Nuts fuelled the athletes!

We enjoyed a great sunny walk there, on Sentosa, with unusual visitors, melodious birds, a suspension bridge n delightful restaurants like Coastes. One could just walk or cycle, n the monorail, island buses n beach shuttles are included in the ticket pricing. If one were energetic enough, one could spend at least 2 to 3 leisurely days there. Fort Siloso is a few shuttle stops away if one didn't want to walk. I would…

1341.a: Japan, 〒257-0015 Kanagawa, Hadano, Hirasawa, 477 Sun's Gelato
1341.aj: 〒257-0015 神奈川県秦野市平沢４７７ Sun's Gelato
1341.ed: People say this gelato shop offers a wide variety of delicious and unique gelato flavors, including seasonal and local ingredient options like tomato and sake lees. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the quality and the bright, clean interior with seating. Guests mention the staff are very kind and provide excellent service.
1341.edj: このジェラートショップを利用した人は、季節限定のフレーバーや地元の食材を使ったユニークなジェラートが豊富に揃っていると評価しています。トマトや酒粕など珍しい味も楽しめ、どれも美味しいという声が多くあります。質の高いジェラートが手頃な価格で提供されている点も評判のようです。店内は明るく清潔感があり、座席も用意されています。スタッフはとても親切で、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This was an unexpected delicious perilla ice cream.

お店に入った瞬間、珈琲の良い香り。 店内も明るくて清潔感があります。 ジェラートは秦野産の食材中心のラインナップ。 お店おすすめの『はるみ（合格祈願米）』はお米の食感もあってとても美味しかったです。プレミアムのチョコラータも濃厚で満足感が高いです。 これほどこだわっているジェラートでは、かなりリーズナブルだと思います。 季節によって色んなフレーバーを提供してくれそうなので、今後も行くのが楽しみです！

84点 トリプル （八重桜、酒粕、湘南ゴールド） ほうじ茶 安い！ しかもめちゃ美味いです！ 買い物の休憩にちょうどいいですね 個人的には酒粕めちゃ美味しかったです。 酒粕って無駄に甘かったり酒臭い感じあるイメージですが、ここのはそういうのはなく、ほのかなお酒の香りですっきり食べれましたー 湘南ゴールドはシャーベットみたいな感じでスッキリした甘さで、リピートする際は定番になるかもです。 八重桜は、今まで食べきた桜アイス系で一番華やかな香りで香料とかじゃない自然で濃い桜の香りがしました。 こちらは春限定ですので、春の間来られる方にはおすすめです。 ほうじ茶もなかなか、ティーバッグにお湯注ぐだけのやつなので、美味しくなるのは後半です。 併設してるはだのじばさんずには今後もお世話になるかと思うので、定期的に足を運びたいと思いました。

1342.a: Japan, 〒105-6490 Tokyo, Minato City, Toranomon, 1 Chome−17−1 Toranomon Hills Business Tower, 3F CARAVAN TORANOMON 横丁
1342.aj: 〒105-6490 東京都港区虎ノ門１丁目１７−１ 虎ノ門ヒルズ ビジネスタワー 3F CARAVAN TORANOMON 横丁
1342.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious New York-style pizza, which offers both crispy and regular crust options, along with a wide variety of creative izakaya dishes. They also highlight the extensive selection of over 50 craft gins and other drinks, and the friendly, attentive staff who create a welcoming atmosphere.
1342.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーは、ニューヨークスタイルの美味しいピザを高く評価しています。ピザはクリスピーとレギュラーの生地を選べるほか、創作居酒屋料理も豊富に揃っているようです。また、50種類以上のクラフトジンをはじめとするドリンクの種類が充実している点や、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフが作り出す居心地の良い雰囲気も好評です。

rv.t: It's a fusion Japanese pizza restaurant inside Toranomon Hill plaza, third floor. Food is OK specially pizza. Like said, fusion! More of Japanese flavor pizza. Full bar. Atmosphere is warm friendly and relaxing. Seating is more of high tables and at the bar. Not good for kids & seniors. Service was really slow despite many workers in the kitchen.

fantastically made kraft cola. Service was friendly, and English menus available. Would return strictly to see the cocktail program which seemed to be executed very well. Pizza was delicious! get soft crust. And edamame spring roll was BANG. Arigato gozaimasu
Great atmosphere and pizza. The staff were super friendly and took the time to get to know us while we waited for our food. Foreigner friendly (:

1343.a: Japan, 〒329-2502 Tochigi, Yaita, Shimoisano, 973 熊さんの村
1343.aj: 〒329-2502 栃木県矢板市下伊佐野９７３ 熊さんの村

rv.t: Awesome ramen in a surprising place.

木曜日10時半頃に初来店しました！ お店迄の道のりはチョイ狭いですね！🤣🤣🤣 ラーメンセット１３００円を注文しました！ ラーメンは細めんで醤油さっぱりしたらラーメンでした！ カレーはスパイスの効かした味がしました！ お店の中はレトロな感じでとても落ち着く空間でした！ 熊さんと食べながらお話ししましたがとても人柄の良い人で沢山お話しをしました！6月の26日27日が蛍祭りを楽しみにしてました！ また、お話に行きたいと思います！ ご馳走さまでした！

那須の「熊さん村」 初めてお伺いしました♡ 矢板の森の奥地 素朴で温かい雰囲気🪟✨ お店に行くまでの道は狭く、どちらかが お譲りする感じです。 駐車場は狭く、手前に3台くらい 奥に4台くらい駐車できます。 中は囲炉裏がある席と、座敷席 空いてる席に座りました。 お冷、お茶は混雑時は セルフらしいです。 ラーメンと、焼きそば大盛り ​🥢 熊さん村の至福の一杯〜🍜✨️ ​🍜ラーメンは 雑味のない、透き通った醤油ラーメンで ​スープを一口飲んだ瞬間に、身体の力が抜けるような優しい味わいでした♡ ​「余計なものが入っていない」という言葉通り、出汁の旨みがストレートに感じられます。 最近の凝りすぎたラーメンとは一線を画す、 毎日でも食べたくなるような清らかな後味でした。 ​麺は細くちぢれ麺。 その黄金色のスープをしっかりと持ち上げてくれています♡ネギやワカメ、たまご、チャーシューのシンプルさも私には丁度よかったです。…

1344.a: Kikicha Tokyo Kichijōji, 1 Chome-9-9 Kichijoji Minamicho, Musashino, Tokyo 180-0003, Japan
1344.aj: 〒180-0003 東京都武蔵野市吉祥寺南町１丁目９−９ 蓬莱茗茶 囍茶東京ー KIKICHA TOKYO
1344.ed: People say this cafe offers a wide variety of authentic Taiwanese teas, including rare selections, and delicious traditional desserts like douhua and pineapple cake. They also highlight the staff's detailed explanations of tea preparation and the calm, relaxing atmosphere. Some reviews mention the prices can be high.
1344.edj: クチコミによると、このカフェでは珍しい種類を含む本格的な台湾茶を幅広く提供しており、豆花やパイナップルケーキといった伝統的なデザートも美味しいと評判です。また、スタッフによる丁寧なお茶の淹れ方の説明や、落ち着いたリラックスできる雰囲気も高く評価されています。 一部のクチコミでは、価格が高めだという意見もあります。

rv.t: 100% recommend, wonderful tea house! It’s Tawainese tea, floral and delicious. The atmosphere was lovely as well as the service. We took also the sweet set which nicely balanced the taste and definitely worth it.

A lovely Taiwanese tea house that serves a lunch set from 11:00 to 13:30. After those hours, they still offer dessert sets and shumai/soup dumplings. They have an extensive selection of tea that is available hot and for some teas, iced as well. The staff were very pleasant and their English was very good. We were able to order without an English menu by using our translator app.

Got a Taiwanese meat pie here for take out when I visited the place. The owner was nice and friendly. I got the green onion and black pepper. The outside is crispy and the inside slightly mochi-esque. The filling is tasty and very juicy! We had the meat pies at Inokashira Park nearby and they were still hot even though we didn’t eat them immediately

1345.a: Japan, 〒321-4217 Tochigi, Haga District, Mashiko, 3508-2 益子のそば 炉庵
1345.aj: 〒321-4217 栃木県芳賀郡益子町益子３５０８−２ 益子のそば 炉庵
1345.ed: Diners like this restaurant's flavorful soba, especially the ten-wari soba, and crispy tempura, along with the unique Burma soup and hearty tororo gohan. They also highlight the welcoming atmosphere, attentive staff, and convenient payment options. Some reviews mention the ten-wari soba can be sold out.
1345.edj: このそば店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、風味豊かなそば、特に十割そばと、サクサクの天ぷらが高く評価されています。また、ユニークなビルマ汁や、とろろご飯も人気のようです。居心地の良い雰囲気や、気の利くスタッフ、便利な支払い方法も好評です。 ただし、十割そばは売り切れている場合があるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Delicious soba and tempura. Authentic restaurant setting. Excellent staff. Well worth a visit!
100% natural soba, worth it even the price is not cheap
Quality soba noodles, tasty crispy tempura and great service! Highly recommend

1346.a: Japan, 〒321-4224 Tochigi, Haga District, Mashiko, Motonuma, 453-1 ブルーベリーと里山と
1346.aj: 〒321-4224 栃木県芳賀郡益子町本沼４５３−１ ブルーベリーと里山と
1346.ed: Visitors say this blueberry farm offers a wide variety of delicious blueberry types for tasting, and many highlight the exceptional blueberry ice cream and smoothies. They also mention the helpful and attentive staff, along with amenities like covered areas for rain and heat, and activities for children.
1346.edj: このブルーベリー農園を訪れた人は、多種多様な美味しいブルーベリーの食べ比べができると評価しています。特に、ブルーベリーアイスクリームやスムージーが絶品というクチコミが多くあります。また、スタッフの対応が親切で丁寧であることや、雨や暑さをしのげる屋根付きの休憩スペース、子ども向けの遊び場などの設備も高く評価されています。

rv.t: ブルーベリ狩りで利用しました🫐 いろんな種類のブルーベリーがありこんなに味が違うのかとびっくりでした！その時におすすめの品種なども教えていただき、スタッフの皆様の対応も素晴らしかったです！ブルーベリー狩り利用者だけ食べれるブルーベリーアイスもシャリシャリ食感で美味しかったです。周りも緑に囲まれており、いいリフレッシュにもなりました。 小さなお子さんも楽しめる空間でしたのでお子様連れも行きやすいと思います。 お手洗いはなく、隣の公衆トイレが利用可能です。

初めて伺いましたが、里山の自然に囲まれたとても素敵な場所でした。ブルーベリー狩りでは、さまざまな品種を食べ比べでき、それぞれ甘さや風味の違いを楽しめて大満足です。時間を忘れて夢中になってしまいました。摘みたてのブルーベリーは本当に美味しく、スタッフの方も親切で気持ちよく過ごせました。ブルーベリーがたっぷり入ったアイスも絶品で、訪れたらぜひ食べてほしいです！また季節を変えて遊びに行きたいと思います。
並ぶことなくスムーズに体験できました。 こんなにブルーベリーの種類があるとは驚きです！ 甘いものから酸味を感じるものまで楽しめました🫐 その場で詰んだブルーベリーをスムージーにしてくれて、すごく美味しかったです！ 都内の喧騒から離れた、自然豊かな場所にあるので、リラックスするにも最適です。

1347.a: Kanahebisui Shrine, Suijin-7 Miiroyoshi, Iwanuma, Miyagi 989-2464, Japan
1347.aj: 〒989-2464 宮城県岩沼市三色吉水神７ 金蛇水神社
1347.ed: Shinto shrine reputed to bring financial luck to pilgrims, with flower displays & cherry blossoms.
1347.edj: 参拝者に金運をもたらすとされる神社。桜をはじめとするさまざまな花が咲き誇る。

rv.t: A very beautiful and peaceful shrine with a unique atmosphere. The snake statues around the grounds are fascinating and meaningful, symbolizing good luck, prosperity, and protection. It was interesting to learn about the blessings connected to the white snake, and many visitors were praying for financial luck and success. The area is clean, relaxing, and perfect for a quiet walk. I also enjoyed the food nearby —…

This shrine, renowned for its good fortune, offers a delightful experience. You could buy a bag for 200yen and bring it to the near by water and wash your money there 🤣🤣🤣. They also have a restaurant and souvenirs related to the shrine. While not particularly large, many locals was visiting too. Some areas are currently under construction, so it would be great to visit after the work is completed.

It’s best to avoid visiting on holidays. When we went on a Sunday, there was a line of cars waiting at the intersection, and another line to enter the shrine. We ended up coming back the next day, on Monday. Be sure to prepare some coins in advance to purchase a waterproof pouch. After the visit, both our bodies and spirits felt cleansed.

1348.a: White Gyoza Kashiwa, 三ツ星ビル 1F 3 Chome-6-9 Kashiwa, Chiba 277-0005, Japan
1348.aj: 〒277-0005 千葉県柏市柏３丁目６−９ 三ツ星ビル 1F ホワイト餃子 柏店
1348.ed: Diners like this restaurant's unique, crispy-skinned fried gyoza with a thick, chewy wrapper and flavorful filling, as well as the delicious water gyoza and soup gyoza. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, the clean interior, and the option to purchase frozen gyoza for takeout. Other reviews mention there can be long wait times.
1348.edj: クチコミによると、このお店では、厚くてもちもちした皮と風味豊かな餡が特徴の、ユニークで皮がカリカリの揚げ焼き餃子や、美味しい水餃子、スープ餃子が高く評価されています。また、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフ、清潔な店内、冷凍餃子をテイクアウトできる点も好評のようです。 一方で、待ち時間が長くなることがあるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Food looks great! I'm excited to be near here, I'm currently waiting for the food.
The best gyoza IMHO, not too garlicky, amazing skin.....I usually take them home frozen from the little counter at the front door, so can’t comment on restaurant service etc.
not that good

1348.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

1349.a: Shimomura Camping Ground, 3077 大室指 Doshi, Minamitsuru District, Yamanashi 402-0204, Japan
1349.aj: 〒402-0204 山梨県南都留郡道志村大室指３０７７ 下村キャンプ場

rv.t: I passed by. But looked nice! Spacious now before summer season..go try it!
6月初旬の平日月火に伺いました。 こじんまりとして料金もお安く僕以外に二組のお客様がいらっしゃいました。目の前の川は浅く子連れならちょっとした水遊びが出来ると思います。413号が目の前なので土日になると夜少し車の音が気になるかも。またぜひ伺います♪

山梨県道志村にある下村キャンプ場は、サイトから真上に見える大室橋の赤い橋脚と緑あふれる山のコントラストが印象的で、「自然の中で贅沢に景色を楽しむ」キャンプ体験ができました。 さらに、夏の時期には目の前を流れる清流・道志川でたっぷり水遊びができ、大人も子どもも川の冷たさと流れの爽快感を満喫できました。サイトは割と自由度が高く、車横付け可能な場所もあって荷物運びも楽チン。 朝の川辺でのひととき、夜の静けさの中で聞こえる水音…「自然と一体になる」感覚をしっかり味わえるキャンプ場です。アクセスも比較的良く、自然系キャンプを求める方にはぜひおすすめしたい場所でした。

1350.a: Norikura Kogen, 鈴蘭 Azumi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-1513, Japan
1350.aj: 〒390-1513 長野県松本市安曇鈴蘭 乗鞍高原
catj: アウトドアイベント企画会社
1350.ed: Scenic nature spot that includes hiking, waterfalls, hot springs & a small ski resort.
1350.edj: ハイキング コース、滝、温泉、小さなスキー場がある美しい自然スポット。

rv.t: We booked in at Raicho Inn at Norikura Kogen to experience three things. An Onsen stay in the mountains, the Kamicochi snow shoe hike tour and a snowy winter experience. It was truly special. It snowed a lot so was stunningly pretty, the onsen experience was wonderful as a result and the hike was magic. We also hiked to a frozen waterfall nearby without snow shoes. Such a fun day and a funny, wonderful experience…
Very beautiful place to visit in autumn. Buses are not very frequent though, and you may have to wait a long time. Lots of bikers on the road, recommend getting the Norikura visitor pass 🍂

Very beautiful place far from tourist trap. Many small beautiful treks are available. Easy to go to Norikura submit from here too. Kamikochi and many beautiful natural onsen with nature view is accessable by bus from here too. I like this place very much. It is so beautiful that I forgot to take any picture.

1351.a: Hatsuhana Soba Honten, 635-635 Yumoto, 箱根町 Hakone, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa 250-0311, Japan
1351.aj: 〒250-0311 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本６３５−６３５ はつ花そば 本店
1351.ed: Long-running spot with 2nd-floor river views, serving handmade buckwheat noodles with yam & tempura.
1351.edj: 2 階の席から川が見える老舗の手打ちそばの店。山かけそばや天ぷらそばを提供。

rv.t: Visited Hatsuhana Soba Honten in Hakone Yumoto and really enjoyed the experience. Be prepared for a 20–30 minute wait, but it doesn’t feel too long since there are many cute shops nearby to explore while waiting. If you get a window-side seat, the view is beautiful and adds so much to the experience. The staff—sweet elderly grandmothers—make the place feel warm and welcoming, almost like eating at home. Their…

It is very nice little soba noodle shop across a little bridge from the main road. It is very old school and I really like the music and decorations. One star off because the servers' vibes were a little standoffish. I guess the other reviews have some truths about the generation. Otherwise, the food was bomb and amazingly delicious! The broths were savory and flavorful. There is an English menu. Like other shops in…

It is also a place more than traditional Japanese, the attention is warm and those who attend are very beautiful women and they try to explain to you if you do not speak the language. There are several hot and cold dishes, you feel a trip to Japan from 100 years ago, and the view of the river and bridge crossing is a plus. Congratulations to the owner and THANK YOU to all those who attend from the reception.

1351.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1352.a: Tsumago-juku, 2196-1 Azuma, Nagiso, Kiso District, Nagano 399-5302, Japan
1352.aj: 〒399-5302 長野県木曽郡南木曽町吾妻２１９６−１ 妻籠宿
1352.ed: Historic town with restored 18th-century homes, 12th-century shrine, 16th-century temple & a museum.
1352.edj: 復元された 18 世紀の家屋、12 世紀の神社、16 世紀の寺院、博物館がある伝統的な町。

rv.t: Its a combination of historical and nature walk. For those who are keen on both like me, this is one of the place in Asia that can be considered. Japan is known to be very clean and neat. Even the toilets are plenty and well kept throughout the walk. They have all the signs very clear, can even walk by ourselves without a crowd, will not worry about getting lost. Feels very safe and refreshing. I did my walk on the…

Tsumago-juku is slightly bigger than Magome-juku and feels just as well-preserved, with a bit more to explore. We visited during sakura season, which made the whole place especially beautiful. This was the only place I got to try kuri kinton. A simple and delicious snack, made from steamed local chestnuts with just a touch of sugar. I also enjoyed freshly made buns made the Edo way. We originally planned to eat…

A relaxing trip back in time! Felt like a movie set, with a constant sound of little streams trickling past. We loved the town and loved the journey to it even more on the Nakasendo trail. It was very easily marked with each trail route and nice surprises around every corner. Highly recommend on your trip to Japan if you want a nice walk and a window into Japan’s past

1353.aj: 石川県加賀市 山中温泉

1354.a: Inawashiro Herb Garden, Tennosaka-2414-16 Kawageta, Inawashiro, Yama District, Fukushima 969-2663, Japan
1354.aj: 〒969-2663 福島県耶麻郡猪苗代町川桁天王坂２４１４−１６ 猪苗代ハーブ園
1354.ed: Visitors say this herb garden features beautiful seasonal flowers like sunflowers and poppies, along with diverse photo opportunities including an umbrella sky installation. They also highlight the affordable 500 yen admission fee and the spacious, free parking. Some reviews mention the flowers can be poorly maintained.
1354.edj: このハーブ園を訪れた人は、ひまわりやポピーなど、季節ごとに美しい花々が楽しめることや、アンブレラスカイの設置をはじめ、多様な写真撮影スポットがあることを評価しています。また、入場料が500円と手頃で、広々とした無料駐車場があることも好評のようです。 一方で、花の手入れがあまり良くないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I really enjoyed visiting Inawashiro Herb Garden! The highlight for me was the colorful Umbrella Sky installation, which makes the perfect Instagram-worthy spot. The garden is beautifully maintained, with vibrant flowers and seasonal herbs that create a relaxing atmosphere. It’s a peaceful place to walk around, take photos, and enjoy the natural scenery. A great destination if you’re in the area and looking for both…

We came here here from Tokyo. This is such an instragrammable place in Fukushima prefecture. The entrance fee is only ¥400. We don’t have a car so me and my friend stayed in a hotel near Koriyama station. From there, we rode train to Kawageta station. From the station, you need to walk approximately 15-20 minutes but that was fine because the view going to the Herb Garden is so peaceful and beautiful. You can also…
Good place to enjoy the natura. Very quiet place to enjoy the view.

1355.a: Subway, 秀和五反田駅前レジデンス 101 1 Chome-4-2 Nishigotanda, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 141-0031, Japan
1355.aj: 〒141-0031 東京都品川区西五反田１丁目４−２ 秀和五反田駅前レジデンス 101 サブウェイ 五反田西口店
catj: ファースト フード店
1355.ed: Casual counter-serve chain for build-your-own sandwiches & salads, with health-conscious options.
1355.edj: オーダーメイドのサンドイッチ、サラダ、ヘルシーなメニューをカウンターで注文するカジュアルなチェーン店。

rv.t: Food is fine but the store stinks the moment you enter.
It's a decent subway located 1 minute from the Gotanda train station.
Consistently good food. Good for vegetarians.

1356.a: Freshness Burger, 三ｯ星ﾋﾞﾙ 1階 1 Chome-11-7 Higashigotanda, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 141-0022, Japan
1356.aj: 〒141-0022 東京都品川区東五反田１丁目１１−７ 三ｯ星ﾋﾞﾙ 1階 フレッシュネスバーガー東五反田店
catj: ファースト フード店
1356.edj: バーガーカフェをコンセプトにした店内は、落ち着きのある雰囲気。オリジナルパティを使用したハンバーガーを提供している。

rv.t: Rustic-looking Freshness Burger I’m Gotanda. Surprisingly spacious, with lots of tables around the corner. Had the salt lemon chicken burger and the fish burger, which I misjudged as they were bigger than expected, but very tasty and hit the spot. Friendly staff member, working hard serving, cooking and cleaning.
I sometimes go to freshness burger chain and like it. But this store was a little dirty. In addition staff is not so friendly. Wish they will be better.
It's a Freshness Burger. I can imagine that this one has more interior space than most and also a nice hint of Americana decor on the walls.

1357.a: M Social Hotel Paris, 12 Bd Haussmann, 75009 Paris, France
1357.aj: M Social Hotel Paris, 12 Bd Haussmann, 75009 Paris, フランス
1357.ed: Sophisticated quarters with free Wi-Fi in a Belle Époque building, plus fine dining & a bar.
1357.edj: 洗練された客室を備えたベルエポック様式のホテル。Wi-Fi 無料。高級レストランとバーがある。

1358.a: Shiraito Falls, 273-1 Kamiide, Fujinomiya, Shizuoka 418-0103, Japan
1358.aj: 〒418-0103 静岡県富士宮市上井出２７３−１ 白糸の滝
1358.ed: Unique, wide waterfall in the scenic, lush surrounds of Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park.
1358.edj: 美しい緑豊かな富士箱根伊豆国立公園にある独特で幅の広い滝。

rv.t: Located in the mountains of Itoshima, Shiraito Falls offers the most natural “air conditioning” to visitors. What a beautiful way to start my weekday getaway here escaping the city heat and enjoying nature! I would like to share with you my self-curated one-day tour (in the order of my visit) in Itoshima. I hope you will find it useful for your planning. 1️⃣ Shiraitono Falls 2️⃣ Forest Cafe Midori no Oto 3️⃣ Ichiran…

Such a pretty waterfall, stretching across a wide part of the valley. The walk down to the second waterfall is well worth it, and so is the walk up to the upper viewpoint – from where you can see Mt Fuji on a clear day and complete the full loop roundtrip back to the car park.

Majestical waterfalls with a Mt Fuji background. Free entry and Exceptional coffee at Mifujiya located near the top car park. Some stairs required to get close to the falls. But viewing is still accessible if you can't.

1359.a: Central Ferry Pier No.5, Man Kwong Street, Hong Kong
1359.aj: Central Ferry Pier No.5, Man Kwong Street, 香港

rv.t: Easy to catch ferry to Cheung Chau from here. Was a bit confusing at first to me. Look up for the signs - when is the next fast ferry vs slow ferry, and cost for each.
Travel on weekday not crowded. Very relaxing trip to Cheung Chau. Payment by cash at the counter or Octopus card. Recommended.

New World First Ferry (or just First Ferry) is a service provider in Hong Kong providing sea bound transportation around Hong Kong including routes to/from outlying islands and popular places such as Cheng Chau, Peng Chau and Mui Wo. Ferry service is similar to the Star Ferry and can be boarded by way of ferry piers. Entry can be purchased by way of cash payment or with an Octopus Card. Route service schedules are…

1360.a: Japan, 〒108-8612 Tokyo, Minato City, Takanawa, 3 Chome−13−1 グランドプリンスホテル B1F ROKKAN
1360.aj: 〒108-8612 東京都港区高輪３丁目１３−１ グランドプリンスホテル B1F ROKKAN
1360.ed: Visitors say this bar offers a unique cocktail and wagashi pairing course, featuring seasonal Japanese craft gin cocktails and exquisite traditional sweets. They also highlight the serene, tea room-inspired atmosphere and the attentive staff who provide detailed explanations. Guests mention the excellent value for the quality and experience, especially for a hotel bar.
1360.edj: このバーを訪れた人は、季節のジャパニーズクラフトジンカクテルと美しい和菓子を組み合わせた、ユニークなペアリングコースを高く評価しています。茶室をイメージした落ち着いた雰囲気や、詳しい説明をしてくれる丁寧なスタッフも好評のようです。ホテルのバーとしては、品質と体験に対して価格が手頃であるという声が多くあります。

rv.t: A++ all the way: drinks, service, atmosphere, value. The only problem: I didn’t like my cocktail, just not right for me, but my wife liked it. So I’ll put 5 stars, don’t like to spoil rating of a great place
Very well executed concepts! The drinks and sweets pairings shone both individually and as a pair. Service was very good too. An enjoyable experience.
Beautiful cocktails paired with delicious wagashi, friendly and efficient service and the right atmosphere and crowd for my session. Love it!

1361.aj: 〒990-2301 山形県山形市蔵王温泉 蔵王山
1361.ed: Seasons change the color of the crater lake on this mountain with "snow monster" trees in winter.
1361.edj: 冬季に「アイス モンスター」と呼ばれる樹氷が見られる山。季節とともに色が変化するクレーター湖がある。

rv.t: Don't come when there's not enough snow in winter: there will only be depressing looking trees and snow that are hard as a stone. So not worth for waiting 3 and a half hours just for the ropeway to get up.

Zao in Yamagata is beautiful in every season, but visiting in the summer has its own special charm. The highlight for me was the crater lake, Okama. The vibrant turquoise color is striking, and seeing it up close on a clear day is genuinely breathtaking. Photos don’t do justice to how vivid the lake looks in person. The surrounding mountains are lush and green during summer, making the whole area feel peaceful and…

This may be one of the most breathtaking places I have ever been in the world. Taking the cable car across the mountain top, and seeing the snow monsters appear from between the clouds was absolutely mind-blowingly beautiful! I cannot wait to return one day and relive this experience!

1362.a: Shonai Hotel Suiden Terrasse, Shimotorinosu-23-1 Kitakyoden, Tsuruoka, Yamagata 997-0053, Japan
1362.aj: 〒997-0053 山形県鶴岡市北京田下鳥ノ巣23−１ ショウナイホテル スイデンテラス
1362.ed: Streamlined rooms in a contemporary hotel with a spa using hot spring water, plus dining & a gym.
1362.edj: 機能的な客室を備えた現代的なホテル。天然温泉を楽しめるスパのほか、レストラン、ジムも併設。

rv.t: I traveled all the way from the Czech Republic specifically to stay at Shonai Hotel Suiden Terrace, and this was my third visit. This time, I stayed for three nights, and once again, the experience exceeded every expectation. This is a truly high-class hotel, both in design and in the quality of the experience it offers. The breakfast is outstanding, featuring an exceptional buffet focused on local Yamagata…

Love this hotel. It's beautifully designed by 坂茂 and it lives up to his fame. The buildings look like they are floating over the rice fields. Both dinners and breakfast were excellent. Most ingredients are sourced locally and they are delicious. But what I love the most is the open baths. Both are small, but they're carefully designed with a tranquil, soothing view. I'd love to come back again just for the hotel.

Highly recommend this hotel. The architecture and design are brilliant. Room is spacious, bed so comfy and overlooking the rice fields (was not the harvesting period when we stayed here though). We included breakfast and dinner in our stay and we were so happy we did so. Dinner was very good, creative and interesting meals. Breakfast spread was very good too. They even provided a warm large blankets for guests who…

1363.a: Japan, 〒250-0311 Kanagawa, Ashigarashimo District, Hakone, Yumoto, 647 RoheN HAKONEYUMOTO cafe&diningbar RoheN HAKONEYUMOTO
1363.aj: 〒250-0311 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町湯本６４７ RoheN HAKONEYUMOTO cafe&diningbar RoheN HAKONEYUMOTO
1363.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, matcha lattes, and freshly baked cookies, with some highlighting the rich matcha terrine. They also mention the beautiful, calming atmosphere created by wooden interiors, plants, and real candles. Guests appreciate the quiet, relaxing space and the convenient self-service style.
1363.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、コーヒーや抹茶ラテ、焼きたてのクッキーが美味しいと評判のようです。特に、濃厚な抹茶のテリーヌを評価する声が多くあります。木製のインテリアや植物、本物のキャンドルが作り出す美しく落ち着いた雰囲気も好評です。静かでリラックスできる空間で、セルフサービスな点も利用しやすいと評価されています。

rv.t: Of all the places I’ve had breakfast in Japan this place was by far my biggest disappointment. Had breakfast at their buffet, it was 4000 Japanese yen for 2 people which I think is reasonable for a buffet, however there were very few options to choose from to even consider it a buffet, and I was shocked when I found out later that coffee is not included. Honestly so disappointed. The food has one salad, cereals…

The coffee is so delicious and strong, by far my favorite coffee in japan! The atmosphere is really nice and views from second floor are beautiful! I love the presentation and little matcha dessert too.
well designed and overall very good place to stay. nice location also. walking distance from hakone-yumoto. staff is super friendly and accommodating. highly recommend

1364.a: Denko Tofu Restaurant, Tora-138-3 Seto, Hakusan, Ishikawa 920-2331, Japan
1364.aj: 〒920-2331 石川県白山市瀬戸寅１３８−３ とうふ 伝好（道の駅 瀬女）
1364.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and hearty tofu dishes, including firm tofu steak, tofu soba, and fried tofu, as well as seasonal and limited-edition offerings. They also highlight the clean and inviting atmosphere, along with the friendly, attentive, and efficient staff. Guests mention the convenient parking and the option for cashless payment.
1364.edj: このレストランを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、しっかりとした豆腐ステーキ、豆腐そば、揚げ出し豆腐など、美味しくてボリュームのある豆腐料理が高く評価されています。季節限定や数量限定のメニューも人気のようです。店内は清潔で居心地の良い雰囲気で、スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかな対応で効率が良いという声が多くあります。また、駐車場が利用しやすく、キャッシュレス決済に対応している点も好評です。

rv.t: Recommended to get the Tōfuzen set. My favorite part of the meal is the miso soup. Main ingredient is tofu but the star of the show is definitely the mushrooms. Please have a visit to this place to fill your stomach.

If you love tofu, Japanese bean curd, this is a must try restaurant. You will enjoy a whole different level of tofu, but you must get there as early as possible since they have only limited servings of tofu dish. I couldn't make it so I had soba, which also turned out to be great with warm, flavourful soup and garnished radish on top. You should also try soy vanila icecream. Seriously, it's fantastic. This is a must…
All the dishes are great!! Will definitely come again.

1365.a: Kashimanada Seaside Park, 390 Otake, Hokota, Ibaraki 311-1513, Japan
1365.aj: 〒311-1513 茨城県鉾田市大竹３９０ 鹿島灘海浜公園
catj: ファーマーズ マーケット
1365.ed: Visitors say this park offers stunning ocean views, well-maintained lawns, and playground equipment, along with a wide variety of local produce and souvenirs at the on-site shop. They also highlight the spacious, free parking and dog-friendly amenities, including a dog run and outdoor dining. Some reviews mention the restrooms can be poorly maintained.
1365.edj: この公園を訪れた人からは、素晴らしい海の眺め、手入れの行き届いた芝生、遊具が好評です。また、敷地内の売店では、地元の新鮮な農産物やお土産が豊富に揃っているという声もあります。広々とした無料駐車場や、ドッグラン、屋外での食事ができるドッグフレンドリーな設備も高く評価されています。 一方で、トイレの清掃が行き届いていないというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: This park offers a variety of amenities with a fantastic ocean view and a long stretch of beach known as “Gold Coast of Ibaraki”. The park has a vast lawn field with a dog run, nature trails, observation decks, playground and ample parking. There is a local produce market with a restaurant located by the parking lot. Spacious restroom is available. 👍👍

Relaxing place. Definitely worth to visit for taking liitle time and unwind. A park and a beach together. If you a surfer you must come here and enjoy the beach and play with the ocean🌊. You can bring food also, but there is a restaurant offering food while relaxing. There is also a huge parking ¥1,000 for the fee until 4 in the afternoon. You must try and visit this place. Super relaxing and enjoying the beautiful…

Nice place for family outing and group picnic. Parking is free. There is a farmer’s market that sells fruit and vegetables. The most popular is the purple sweet potato. I came here on Sunday, September 8th 2024 with a group of 50 people. The weather was alright. Not too hot and not too cold. You can walk your dogs and play frisbee here. Children can play on the playground or go to the beach.

1366.a: Japan, 〒401-0511 Yamanashi, Minamitsuru District, Oshino, Shibokusa, 1229-1 富士山温泉 八海木花館
1366.aj: 〒401-0511 山梨県南都留郡忍野村忍草１２２９−１ 富士山温泉 八海木花館
1366.ed: Guests mention this ryokan offers stunning views of Mount Fuji from all rooms, along with private open-air baths and delicious, locally sourced meals that accommodate dietary requests. They also highlight the spacious, clean, and luxurious rooms, as well as the convenient free taxi service from Mount Fuji Station. Visitors appreciate the attentive and professional staff, who provide excellent…
1366.edj: この旅館を利用した人は、すべての部屋から富士山の素晴らしい景色が見えると評価しています。また、プライベートな露天風呂や、地元の食材を使ったおいしい食事が高く評価されており、食事の要望にも対応してもらえるようです。広々として清潔感のある豪華な部屋も好評で、富士山駅から無料のタクシーサービスがあるのも便利という声があります。利用した人は、スタッフの気配りやプロフェッショナルな対応に感謝しており、素晴らしいサービスと穏やかで思い出に残る体験ができたというクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: The place is located at Oshino. From a far you could view Mount Fuji. Unfortunately on the day of check in till we checked out, the weather was cloudy, misty and raining which covered Mt. Fuji all the time. The property is new and the suite is lovely with private onsen. Food is delicious which serves breakfast and dinner. I would strongly recommend this place if you are into a quick retreat and peaceful gateway.

We had the most amazing stay here. The food and service were amazing. The hot bath was incredible and we spent several hours just sitting in it. Yes, it’s a little out of the way of everything near Mt. Fuji but it was the perfect change in scenery for us after spending a few days in Tokyo. They offer a free taxi service around the area or it is a 10 minute walk from the closest bus station.

The stay was very comfortable, clean and with great facilities/amenities. The food was also lovely with detailed explanations by the staff, who were friendly and warm. This was located near oshino Hakkai and was a short drive by car. The best thing was the view of Mount Fuji!

1367.a: Fujitsuki, 1 Chome-1-93 Sakuragicho, Naka Ward, Yokohama, Kanagawa 231-0062, Japan
1367.aj: 〒231-0062 神奈川県横浜市中区桜木町１丁目1−９３ ふじ月
1367.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh, high-quality crab, prepared in various ways like sashimi, shabu-shabu, and grilled, with many highlighting the impressive crab dismantling show. They also mention the chic, upscale atmosphere, which is perfect for special occasions, and the attentive, knowledgeable staff who provide excellent service.
1367.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、新鮮で質の高いカニ料理を高く評価しています。刺身、しゃぶしゃぶ、焼きガニなど、様々な調理法で提供されるカニはどれも絶品で、特に目の前で行われるカニの解体ショーは圧巻という声が多くあります。また、シックで高級感のある雰囲気は特別な日の食事にぴったりで、知識豊富で気の利くスタッフによる丁寧なサービスも高く評価されています。

rv.t: We enjoyed the Golden King Crab for dinner, and it was truly an incredible and memorable experience. The crab was exceptionally fresh, and the chef prepared it using a variety of cooking methods like shabu shabu, sashimi, steamed egg, and crab with rice — each dish was absolutely amazing. The staff communicated fluently in English, which made the experience even more comfortable and enjoyable. The only downside was…

桜木町駅からすぐという抜群のアクセスに位置する ふじ月。 駅近とは思えないほど、落ち着いた空間で本格的な蟹料理を堪能できる一軒です。 ここは“蟹を味わい尽くす”という表現すら物足りないほどの完成度。 これほどまでに蟹を食べ尽くした体験は初めてで、今回はイバラガニを選択。 ぎっしりと詰まった身は繊維の一本一本まで力強く、噛むほどに濃厚な旨みが広がります。 刺身の瑞々しさ、香ばしさを引き出す焼き、甘みを最大限に引き出すレア焼きと、同じ蟹とは思えないほど多彩な表情を楽しめるのも魅力です。 さらに料理に寄り添うペアリングのお酒も秀逸で、ひと皿ごとの完成度を引き上げてくれる存在。 目の前で繰り広げられる調理のライブ感あるパフォーマンスも相まって、食事は五感で楽しむエンターテインメントへと昇華されています。 締めの土鍋ご飯と蟹のほぐし身はおにぎりにして持ち帰れる心遣いも嬉しく、帰宅後まで余韻が続く、記憶に残る名店です。

rv.a: 食べることが好きな人
rv.t: 【雰囲気・サービス】 「湘南沖地蟹専門店ふじ月」は 桜木町駅から徒歩20秒ほど の立地にある蟹料理専門店で、完全予約制のコース主体のレストランです。駅すぐという便利さながら、落ち着いたシックな空間で、カウンター席と 4名程度の個室 を完備。カウンターでは調理のライブ感を楽しみながら食事ができます。サービスは丁寧で、コースの進行や飲み物の提案もスムーズでした。 【料理】 イバラガニを中心に、季節の希少蟹を活きた状態で水槽から取り出し、その場で調理するスタイルが特徴。茹で・蒸し・焼き・刺し・しゃぶしゃぶなど、素材それ自体の甘みと風味をストレートに味わえる皿が続きます。 鮮度の高い蟹は身のプリッとした食感と深い旨味があり、蟹本来の香りを感じられる仕上がりでした。…

1367.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

1368.a: Gyeongju Station, 80 Singyeongjuyeok-ro, Geoncheon-eup, Gyeongju-si, Gyeongsangbuk-do, South Korea
1368.aj: 新慶州駅 ８０ Singyeongjuyeok-ro, Geoncheon-eup, Gyeongju-si, Gyeongsangbuk-do, 韓国

rv.t: Singyeongju Station is modern, clean, and well organized. The facilities are convenient, signs are easy to follow, and the station provides a comfortable experience for travelers. A great gateway to Gyeongju.

SRT and KTZ subway. Modern and clean and easy to use and find your way around. Self serve machines and also in English. Love how Korea has shopping in every train station. Out of town but no too far in uber/taxi

It's huge,if you like trains go to a platform with a train pending to come and you can watch other high-speed trains wizz past on the secondary lines. I'd suggest going to any platform but the station stuff might ask you to head back down.

1369.a: Musée d'Orsay, Esplanade Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, 75007 Paris, France
1369.aj: オルセー美術館 Esplanade Valéry Giscard d'Estaing, 75007 Paris, フランス
1369.ed: Major 19th- & 20th-century European art collections housed in a monumental, former railway station.
1369.edj: かつて鉄道駅だった大きな建物を活用した有名な美術館。19～20 世紀の西洋美術コレクションを所蔵。

rv.t: I think this museum is absolutely beautiful. I visited on a Thursday evening and didn’t have much time, but I still had a wonderful experience. I’ll definitely come back one day to explore it properly. I mainly wanted to visit the fifth floor, which I did, and the paintings there are simply spectacular. And of course, the famous clock is absolutely stunning. The view through it over Paris is just beautiful. I can…

The Musée d’Orsay is one of the most beautiful museums in Paris, especially famous for its incredible collection of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist art. Housed in a former railway station, the building itself is stunning, with its huge glass clock and open, elegant interior. Inside, you’ll find masterpieces by artists like Vincent van Gogh, Claude Monet, and Édouard Manet. The museum feels bright and spacious…

Really great museum. Although the stunning impressionist painting takes away all the attention and other exhibits are neglected. They should just make this one for impressionism only. Very crowded. Particularly the Vincent Van Gogh gallery. Most people just snap a photo and move on. Then why come all the way to the museum. Books shops are well stocked. The cafe is very crowded. They should provide more seating space…

I had a very fun time riding a horse on the beach. Great place to learn to ride a horse

1371.a: Japan, 〒160-0022 Tokyo, Shinjuku City, Shinjuku, 3 Chome−26−11 5f タカノフルーツティアラ
1371.aj: 〒160-0022 東京都新宿区新宿３丁目２６−１１ 5f タカノフルーツティアラ
catj: スイーツおよびデザート ビュッフェ
1371.ed: Diners like this cafe's wide variety of fresh, seasonal fruits, beautifully cut and arranged by staff, and the option to enjoy an afternoon tea set. They also highlight the generous 120-minute time limit and the fact that children under six eat for free. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient due to long lines.
1371.edj: クチコミによると、このフルーツパーラーでは、新鮮な旬のフルーツが美しくカットされ、盛り付けられて提供されており、アフタヌーンティーセットも楽しめると評判です。予約システムが便利で、6歳未満の子どもは無料で食事ができる点も好評のようです。 一方で、カットフルーツは提供までに待ち時間が発生することもあるという声もあります。

rv.t: 新宿高野が手がける“季節ごとのフルーツ食べ放題×アフタヌーンティー”が楽しめる場所で我が家のとてもお気に入りの場所。 新宿駅出てすぐ。 ・旬のカットフルーツが120分食べ放題 ・3段スタンドのアフタヌーンティー付き ・スタッフが目の前で美しく盛り付けしてくれる ・苺、メロン、マンゴー、シャインマスカットなど季節ごとに内容が変わる ・見た目が華やかで“映え”抜群📸 ・紅茶やコーヒーもおかわり自由 ☕ ドリンクの種類は、紅茶、コーヒーのみなのでもう少し種類が増えたらもっといいなぁといつも思います。(子供用にジュースはもらえます) それでも6歳未満は無料なので、フルーツ大好きな子連れでいくとこれ無料でいいの！？と驚く豪華さ&爆食です。フルーツ大好きな人には最高だとおもいます。いつもありがとうございます。

有名店の食べ放題への期待と事前に口コミを調べて、長時間並ぶことへの不安などもあり、そわそわした気持ちで伺いました。 待っている間にも続々と並ぶ列が伸びていて、予想通りとはいえ戦々恐々としました。。 当日はベビーカーを持ったファミリーやお子さま連れの方々も数組見受けられました。 ちなみに、お子様もフルーツ食べ放題の列に並ぶと保護者とは別に自由に、大人同様に選んで1皿もらえますので保護者の方が何度も取りに行かなくてはいけないのでは・・・？？という心配はありません。 肝心のフルーツですが、カットするスタッフの方によって量や盛り付け方、スピードがかなり差が出ます。 1回につき4種類まで〜となっていますが、同じ物だけであったり2種類だけであったりすることもできます。 1つ分のボリュームが決まっているようなので要望をしっかり伝えてください。 （2つのフルーツだけを伝えると、4つぶんよりも少量になります→2/4のボリューム）…

新宿に来るとつい立ち寄ってしまう、老舗フルーツ専門店のパフェリオ本店。フルーツのクオリティはさすがの一言です。 今回はいちごのアフタヌーンティーセットを利用しましたが、まず見た目の華やかさにテンションが上がります。上段のいちごシュークリームは、甘すぎないクリームとフレッシュないちごのバランスが絶妙。中段のチョコババロアや苺ヨーグルトも上品な甘さで、最後まで飽きずに楽しめました。 下段のチキンとブロッコリーのリングパンや苺入りサラダなど、甘いだけでなく軽食も入っているのが嬉しいポイント。しっかりボリュームもあり、120分ゆっくり過ごせるのも魅力です。 何よりフルーツが本当に新鮮で、キウイやパイナップル、柑橘類までどれもみずみずしく、専門店の実力を感じます。 価格はやや高めですが、その分クオリティと満足度は高い印象。特別な日や、ちょっと贅沢なティータイムにおすすめです。

1372.a: Ko Phi Phi Don, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi, Thailand
1372.aj: タイ クラビー ムアンクラビー アオナン ピーピー・ドーン島
1372.ed: Largest island in the Ko Phi Phi archipelago, featuring scenic inlets, beach resorts & restaurants.
1372.edj: 美しい入り江で知られる、ピーピー諸島最大の島。ビーチリゾート、レストランがある。

rv.t: I had an amazing experience visiting Phi Phi Islands! The scenery is absolutely breathtaking with crystal-clear turquoise water, stunning limestone cliffs and soft white sand beaches. It truly feels like paradise. We joined a tour to Maya Bay and did some snorkeling, and it was one of the best experiences ever. and we saw so many colorful fish swimming around us — it felt like being inside an aquarium. The boat…

Koh Phi Phi Don is a stunning tropical destination that perfectly balances vibrant social energy with breathtaking natural beauty. As the only inhabited island in the archipelago, it serves as the main hub where you’ll find a wide variety of charming guesthouses, lively beachfront bars, and delicious local eateries.

We visited this island during our Phi Phi islands tour. It is the largest island in the area and has resorts and restaurants. So this is where we had our lunch and relaxed a bit. The beaches are beautiful. We also tried some snorkeling near this island. We did not have enough time to visit the view points as we were visiting Maya bay too.

1373.a: Long Beach Koh Phi Phi, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000, Thailand
1373.aj: Long Beach Koh Phi Phi, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000 タイ

rv.t: Gorgeous beach. Good eating and a 30 minute walk from Tonsai Central. Get some exercise but wear some walking sneakers. Eat drink and take the long boat back to the pier.1

I loved the island. Apparently Long Beach has been a bit overcrowded and snorkeling right at the beach hasn‘t been as spectacular as I thought. But all in all i definitely recommend to spend some hours at the beach and admire the wonderful nature. Restaurants are also available as well as sun beds for 100 bath. I recommend buying the tickets for the ferry to phi phi one day ahead, because the first day we arrived…

We stayed in Pating and booked a day trip to Phi Phi islands. The tour guide picked us up from our hotel by mini van and took us to a pier on the East side of Phuket. From there we went by speed boat 45 min ride) to Phi Phi island. Spent time there, swam in the ckear blue water had lunch and stopped by a few other islands on the way back to Phuket mainland. The water is clear and you can enjoy a swimming there.

1374.a: Pi Leh Bay, เกาะพีพี(อ่าวแหลมตง, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000, Thailand
1374.aj: ピレィラグーン เกาะพีพี(อ่าวแหลมตง, Ao Nang, Mueang Krabi District, Krabi 81000 タイ
1374.ed: Picturesque swimming inlet known for its clear waters & popular with snorkelers.
1374.edj: 海水浴ができる、景色の美しい入り江。澄んだ水で知られ、シュノーケリングの人気スポットとなっている。

rv.t: Honestly, this was the best part of our boat trip. The water is a crazy bright blue and so clear ❤️ it feels like swimming in a giant natural pool. Jumping off the boat into the lagoon was a total highlight. It does get pretty crowded with other boats around midday, but it’s still absolutely worth seeing. Just a stunning spot for a swim and some great photos

Pi Leh Bay (often called Pileh Lagoon) is the definition of "looks great on the 'gram, but that's about it." Since it’s tucked away on the uninhabited Koh Phi Phi Leh, you can’t actually stay there—it’s strictly a pit-stop destination. The emerald water and limestone cliffs are undeniably paradise-coded, but the reality is a bit of a parking lot for long-tail boats. If you’re expecting a National Geographic…

A breathtaking place in Thailand. The water is one of the most beautiful I have ever seen and taking the tailboat was truly one of the highlights of my trip. It is a calm place, surrounded by tall cliffs.

1375.a: Curry Hanaco (Veggie), 2F 3 Chome-8-3 Motookubo, Narashino, Chiba 275-0012, Japan
1375.aj: 〒275-0012 千葉県習志野市本大久保３丁目８−３ 2F 南インド食堂 葉菜子
1375.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic South Indian cuisine, which features a variety of flavorful vegetarian and vegan dishes. They also highlight the warm and welcoming atmosphere, along with the staff's deep knowledge of Indian culture and cuisine. Guests mention the convenient paid parking nearby and the option to reserve a special banana leaf meal.
1375.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、本格的な南インド料理を高く評価しています。風味豊かなベジタリアン料理やヴィーガン料理が豊富に揃っているのが特徴です。温かく居心地の良い雰囲気や、スタッフのインド文化と料理に関する深い知識も好評のようです。また、近くに有料駐車場があり、特別なバナナリーフミールを予約できる点も利用した人から良いクチコミがあります。

rv.t: Absolutely delicious southern Indian cuisine. It is full of nutrients and you’ll leave full, happy, and feeling healthier. Highly recommend to anyone in the Tokyo or Chiba area to make a trip here; check their instagram page for their opening hours ahead of time as it is not posted on Google Maps. They do a special banana leaf meal at the end of every month by reservation only Instagram only (English is ok)… would…

If you are indian you must come here. The food is sattvic, vegetarian and healthy. She makes it with all her heart and the food is exactly like you would eat in someones home in india. So beautiful that the real culture of india is being spread here. We also had a chai.

Superb ,Amazingly prepared Indian Satwik Food with subtle taste and one keep licking fingers . These two sisters have trained themselves for this Food preparation from Maharashtra and are really worth having lunch here .

1376.a: HI,COFFEE HEY,HERB, 鶯谷北野ビル 1F 4-15 Uguisudanicho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0032, Japan
1376.aj: 〒150-0032 東京都渋谷区鶯谷町４−１５ 鶯谷北野ビル 1F HI,COFFEE HEY,HERB

1376.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, a wide selection of organic herbal teas, and tasty gluten-free banana bread. They also highlight the cozy, relaxing atmosphere and the friendly, welcoming staff. Visitors appreciate that it opens early and is dog-friendly.
1376.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、おいしいコーヒーや種類豊富なオーガニックハーブティー、グルテンフリーのバナナブレッドが評判のようです。居心地が良く落ち着いた雰囲気や、親しみやすいスタッフの対応も高く評価されています。また、朝早くから営業している点や、犬同伴が可能な点も利用した人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: We had a wonderful visit here and can’t stop thinking about it! The coffee was absolutely delicious — perfectly balanced and expertly made. But the real surprise was the vegan banana bread and vegan blueberry scone both are moist, flavorful, and the ideal companion to our cups. The kind of treat that makes you slow down and savor every bite. If you’re a coffee lover who appreciates a great baked good alongside your…

I just stopped in for a coffee and really enjoyed the place. It’s small with limited seating, but there are a couple of seats outside which was nice. I ordered a pour over which was good. They also have quite a few tea options if that’s your thing. There are also several sweets you can choose from too. The service was super friendly and accommodating.

This place had the best espresso-based coffee we had during our entire 2-week trip to Japan (and this is coming from people who make their own espresso daily at home). We visited 4 times during our stay and the cappuccinos and lattes (both iced and hot) were absolutely fantastic, and the pastries they had were great too. They also sell custom tea blends that we got as gifts. The ladies who work there are very sweet…

1377.a: Haeundae Blueline Park - Cheongsapo Station, 청사포정거장 2F 116 Cheongsapo-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan, South Korea

rv.t: We didn’t buy tickets in advance because we weren’t sure what time we’d arrive. We ended up purchasing tickets on-site at around 13:00 and got a slot for 14:00, which worked out perfectly. It gave us enough time to grab an iced coffee at Mellow Café and take a relaxing walk to Cheongsapo near the lighthouses before heading back with about 15 minutes to spare. The cabins are quite small, but the nice thing is that…

We had a great time here. We took both the train and the sky capsule. Even though all the tickets for sky capsule was sold out weeks before on online, we were lucky to get it on the spot for that day at the station. It was absolutely beautiful and memorable.

Cheongsapo Station is a beautifully located seaside station and one of the main boarding points for the famous Sky Capsule ride in Busan. The station itself is neat, well organised and offers stunning coastal views even before the ride begins. The colourful capsules moving along the shoreline create a very picturesque atmosphere. With cafés, lighthouse walks and ocean breeze nearby, the whole experience feels calm…

We did the Army Ducks tour in Wisconsin Dells and overall it was a fun experience. The scenic drive through the trails and nature areas was beautiful and honestly the best part of the tour.
